import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, k, mod;
    static int[] jc = new int[262155];
    static int[] inv = new int[262155];
    static int[] jc2 = new int[262155];
    static int[] Log = new int[262155];
    static int[][] dp = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[262155][31];
    static List<Pair> tp = new ArrayList<>();
    static Map<Pair, Boolean> visitedPairs = new HashMap<>();

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int a, int b) {
            this.first = a;
            this.second = b;
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair p = (Pair) o;
            return first == p.first && second == p.second;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static void R(BufferedReader br, int[] v) throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine();
        String[] parts = line.trim().split("\\s+");
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            v[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
    }

    static long ksm(int x, long y) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = x;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int getcnt(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (x != 0 && x % 2 == 0) {
            cnt++;
            x /= 2;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int C(int n, int m) {
        return (int)(((long)jc[n] * inv[m] % mod) * inv[n - m] % mod);
    }

    static int dfs(int n, int k) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        if (k == 0) return 0;
        if (dp[n][k] != -1) return dp[n][k];
        int di = 1 << Log[n];
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = n; i >= di; i -= 2) {
            long temp = ((long)C(n, i) * dfs(n - i, k - 1)) % mod;
            ret = (int)((ret + temp * k) % mod);
        }
        return dp[n][k] = ret;
    }

    static int bfs(int n, int k) {
        Queue<Pair> que = new LinkedList<>();
        que.offer(new Pair(n, k));
        while (!que.isEmpty()) {
            Pair front = que.poll();
            n = front.first;
            k = front.second;
            tp.add(new Pair(n, k));
            if (n == 0 || k == 0) continue;
            int di = 1 << Log[n];
            for (int i = n; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                Pair p = new Pair(i, k - 1);
                if (jc2[i] + jc2[n - i] == jc2[n] && !visitedPairs.getOrDefault(p, false)) {
                    visitedPairs.put(p, true);
                    que.offer(p);
                }
            }
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = tp.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            Pair p = tp.get(i);
            n = p.first;
            k = p.second;
            if (n == 0) {
                dp[n][k] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (k == 0) {
                dp[n][k] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            int di = 1 << Log[n];
            for (int i = n; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                if (jc2[i] + jc2[n - i] == jc2[n]) {
                    long temp = ((long)C(n, i) * dp[n - i][k - 1]) % mod;
                    dp[n][k] = (int)((dp[n][k] + temp * k) % mod);
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[n][k];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        k = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        mod = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[2]);

        int[] input = new int[3];
        R(br, input);
        n = input[0];
        k = input[1];
        mod = input[2];

        Arrays.fill(dp, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 262155; i++) {
            jc[i] = (int)(((long)jc[i - 1] * i) % mod);
            Log[i] = (i > 0) ? Log[i >> 1] + 1 : -1;
            jc2[i] = (i > 0) ? jc2[i - 1] + getcnt(i) : 0;
        }
        inv[262154] = (int)ksm(jc[262154], mod - 2);
        for (int i = 262153; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)(((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod);
        }
        inv[0] = inv[1];

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(ksm(k, n));
        } else {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
                if (((long)n & (1L << i)) != 0) cnt++;
            }
            int ans = (int)ksm(k, n);
            int result = (int)((ans - bfs(n, k)) % mod);
            if (result < 0) result += mod;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
